encounters.notes: Kuro-Truce streets at Crimson Night: the first ashigaru line; one repaints itself unless FIRE lands first.
Kanji hitboxes over wet ink; teaches the ink DoT.
Oil-vein townsfolk and an imp swarm; the Heimin burst into Ash Fields Krona can feed on.
Unpainted yokai evade everything until Cobalt Wash or an INK hit paints them; the crow blinds from above.
First Iron Bridge shrine: the ash-ronin's 2 s ink pose forces a held Ens Parry.
Second Iron Bridge shrine: a Porcelain Captain leads the line and trails VHS Fog.
Third Iron Bridge shrine: two samurai pose at once while the crow applies BLIND.
Fourth Iron Bridge shrine before Goyama: the full parry exam.
